rules.sentence: Antibiotic therapy is the cornerstone of vertebral osteomyelitis treatment.
Most experts recommend 6 weeks of antimicrobial therapy,[16] as longer treatment durations have not shown increased efficacy for typical cases.[2]

Surgical management is rarely indicated, except in cases involving neurological compromise, significant vertebral destruction with spinal instability, large epidural abscess formation, intractable back pain, or failure of medical therapy.[2]
However, recent studies suggest that surgical intervention does not increase the risk of adverse clinical outcomes in patients with known or suspected vertebral osteomyelitis.[17]
